description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book the Lovely Home: * Less than a mile from the Beach - Gulf View Heights Access * 4 Bikes Included * Multiple porches and screened-in outdoor space perfect for relaxing * Community Pool, Grills, Covered Picnic Area, and Playground * Quiet Gated Neighborhood, Catch and Release Lake, and Nature Trails * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults under age 25. No Exceptions. * Welcome to The Greenhouse, a beautifully designed 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath Florida cottage tucked away on a quiet private cul-de-sac in the charming Forest Lakes community. Thoughtfully designed for both comfort and relaxation, this inviting retreat features nearly 500 square feet of outdoor living space, including two covered porches and a screened-in porch perfect for morning coffee, evening cocktails, or gathering with family and friends. Inside, the first floor offers a spacious open-concept layout with a cozy family room, dining area, fully equipped kitchen, laundry room, half bath, and a luxurious king master suite. Upstairs, guests will find a second king master suite along with a fun guest room featuring queen-over-queen bunk beds, making it ideal for families or groups. The kitchen is stocked with everything needed to prepare delicious meals, while extras like the porch swing and complimentary bikes make your stay even more enjoyable. During your vacation, unwind by the peaceful neighborhood lake, explore scenic walking trails, lounge at the community pool, or bike to the nearby sugar-white beaches of 30A. Conveniently located near Gulf Place Town Center, The Greenhouse places you close to local dining, boutique shopping, and all the beauty and charm the area has to offer, creating the perfect setting for unforgettable beach memories. Forest Lakes neighborhood has an idyllic setting overlooking a peaceful lake with thousands of acres of state forest bordering the community. Completely secluded and quiet, it's hard to believe Highway 30A is just outside the community and offers quick access to all the amenities you could desire in this South Santa Rosa Beach location. The recently renovated community pool offer a relaxing dip after a long day at the beach. Make memories on the fishable lake, that's catch and release, and there's also a lovely, covered picnic area with grills, as well as a playground for the kiddos. Blue Mountain Beach is just to the east, and the shops, entertainment, and dining venues of Gulf Place Town Center are a short drive to the west. Incredible white sand beaches are a few minutes down the road. Please note this home is located within an HOA community. Guests are required to follow all community rules and regulations, carefully review the rental agreement in full, and observe all posted community rules in the home to ensure a smooth and enjoyable stay. There are 2 parking places available for this home, inclusive of any rented LSVs, requiring 2 parking placards that must be placed in vehicles when in the community. There is no street parking or overflow available for guest use. Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Master Bedroom1: King Bed 2nd Floor:Master Bedroom 2: King Bed Guest Bedroom 2: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed Area Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
